extension.news:
0.3.0~beta1 - Adds export and import to the Programs menu - Returns to the Programs menu after each action instead of closing it - Keeps several installs in sync through a shared folder, turned on under Export / Import - Puts the newer changes from an import into the library, not only into its own saved data
0.2.0~beta1-3 - Saves play counts, last played times, resume points and user ratings as you watch - Puts them back after a library rebuild, matched on unique id so a rename or a move survives - Fills the library back in on its own once a rebuild settles, only where Kodi holds nothing - Restores everything from Programs, or one movie or show from its context menu - Undoes any restore, including one it made itself - Moves your saved data to another install, and merges one back in - Exports a readable list of everything saved - Never lowers a play count the library already holds, and leaves a cleared resume point cleared - Keeps the highest play count and newest date across copies of a title - Waits until no video has played for a few minutes before filling in or backing up
extension.summary: Keeps your watched history, resume points and ratings through a library rebuild
extension.description: Watchkeeper keeps watch over play counts, resume points and user ratings, recording them as they change and putting them back after a library rebuild. It runs as a service. A restore can also be run from Programs or from a movie or show's context menu, and undone.
